name: Chain Lightning
summary: +1 passive relic or ranged weapon damage and five packets of 5 Vorpal Lightning. Can be spent for a 3 second blink.

name: Gust of Wind
summary: Gain three packets of Magic Knockback 10 for the encounter.

name: Levitate
summary: Float 3 inches up: ignore ground effects and falling damage. No feet-planted skills (such as Storm) while active.

name: Lightning Bolt
summary: One packet: 25 Vorpal Lightning.

name: Whispering Wind
summary: Send a message of up to 20 words to someone you have met. Cannot cross planes; no delivery confirmation.

name: Grant Haste
summary: Grant one use of Speed of Blade and one use of Blink.

name: Grant Mirror Image
summary: Grant one Evasion use that also triggers an immediate blink.

name: Group Avoid Trap
summary: Four targets each gain Avoid Trap, a Phase that stops one trap effect.

name: Static Charge
summary: +2 passive relic or ranged weapon damage and five packets of 10 Vorpal Lightning. Can be spent for a 3 second blink.

name: Thunderclap
summary: Frontal Cone 50 Air and Stun 5 seconds.

name: Lightning Blast
summary: One packet: Lash 50 Lightning and Stun 5 seconds.

name: Confine
summary: Magic Confine: target frozen from the neck down, may use only Resist or Focus skills.

name: Lightning Whip
summary: Slay and 50 Vorpal Lightning on one target.

name: Wall of Force
summary: Wall up to 10 ft long and 10 ft tall that blocks passage (Passwall bypasses). One wall or circle at a time; needs a phys rep.

name: Boom of Thunder
summary: Voice Radius Stun 5 seconds.

name: Cunning of Air
summary: Target is Hastened and pays one less use (minimum 1) for Search, Hide, Pick Locks, and Disarm Trap.

name: Forked Lightning
summary: Two packets, each Slay and 100 Vorpal Lightning.

name: Portal
summary: Open a portal (hanging cloth) for 5 minutes to a familiarized place on Sylvaris; 3 count to enter or exit, at least 1 minute travel. The caster can shut it with a 10 count.

name: Raging Winds
summary: +5 passive relic or ranged weapon damage and 5 packets of 25 Vorpal Lightning. Can be spent for Stun immunity for the encounter.

name: Thunderwave
summary: A Lash Slay centred on yourself; once per encounter.

name: Channel the Grave
summary: +25 Temporary Life Points and five packets (one at a time) of 10 Harm.

name: Death Sight
summary: See the last minute before death through the dead person's eyes.

name: End the Cycle
summary: Willing, free-willed target only: Unavoidable, Irresistible Magic Death over several hours; frees all Spirit Fragments and blesses the corpse against necromancy.

name: Enshroud Life
summary: Target looks undead to basic undead.

name: Life Drain
summary: One packet of 25 Harm, then one packet of 10 Healing.

name: Animate Dead
summary: A corpse walks under Magic Slow to a named place; its death timer pauses while it travels.

name: Final Command
summary: Final Command 30 seconds: Magic Enslave Undead, then one Slay when it ends.

name: Resuscitate
summary: Living target only: if they die and are still dead a minute later, they revive at half Life Points.

name: Siphon Life
summary: Gain 3 uses of Life Drain (25 Harm then 10 Healing) for the encounter.

name: Speak with Dead
summary: Ask a corpse one question; it answers in one sentence as truthfully as it can.

name: Circle of Death
summary: Circle up to 10 ft across that no living creature can cross. One wall or circle at a time; needs a phys rep.

name: Death Immunity
summary: Death effects have no effect on the target until the re-pop ends.

name: Reaper's Blade
summary: Target's weapon, claws, bite, or Relic deals +2 Harm for the re-pop, or until spent on one Harm Slay.

name: Siphon Strength
summary: Five packets of Magic Weakness, each followed by a packet granting +1 passive damage for the encounter (max one such bonus per person). Unused packets end with the encounter.

name: Storm of Atrophy
summary: Feet planted, throw repeated Storm 10 Weakness until you move, take an effect, use a skill, or the encounter ends.

name: Finger of Death
summary: One Point Magic Death.

name: Mass Final Command
summary: Voice Radius Final Command 30 seconds: Magic Enslave Undead, then one Slay when it ends.

name: Pillar of Death
summary: Gain three Magic Slay packets for the encounter.

name: Grant Intercept
summary: Grant one use of Intercept.

name: Grant Orc Strength
summary: +1 passive melee weapon/claw damage and 5 melee attacks of 10 Crush. Can be spent for a 3 count rip free.

name: Grant Resilience
summary: Grant one use of Resilience.

name: Pin
summary: Magic Pin: left foot pinned for a 100 count rip free.

name: Grant Earth Armor
summary: +25 Temporary Armor Points.

name: Grant Ogre Strength
summary: +2 passive melee weapon/claw damage and 5 melee attacks of 25 Crush. Can be spent to resist a movement-impairing effect.

name: Group Grant Resilience
summary: Four targets each gain one use of Resilience.

name: Stone Fist
summary: Three melee weapon/claw attacks of 50 Crush.

name: Group Grant Earth Armor
summary: Four targets each gain +25 Temporary Armor Points.

name: Group Grant Ogre Strength
summary: Four targets each gain +2 passive weapon damage and 5 melee attacks of 25 Crush; can be spent to resist a movement-impairing effect.

name: Stoneskin
summary: Resist Damage against the next damaging effect, then Retaliate Shatter Weapon.

name: Web
summary: Magic Web: frozen from the neck down; a bladed weapon cuts the target free on a 100 count.

name: Earthquake
summary: Call "Voice Radius Magic Pin 30 seconds".

name: Grant Titan Strength
summary: +5 passive melee weapon/claw damage and 5 melee attacks of 50 Crush. Can be spent for Pin, Web, and Knockback immunity for the encounter.

name: Harden Armaments
summary: Voice Radius Grant Resist Shatter.

name: Imprison
summary: Magic Imprison: target fully disabled, only the caster can affect them; ends when the caster does or after 5 minutes.

name: Fire Blade
summary: Target's weapon, claws, or bite deal Fire for the re-pop, or until spent on one attack at +20 Fire.

name: Fire Burst
summary: One packet: Lash 25 Fire.

name: Fire Dart
summary: One packet: 50 Fire.

name: Inferno
summary: Five packets, one at a time, of 15 Fire.

name: Dragon's Breath
summary: Frontal Cone 100 Fire.

name: Fire Volley
summary: Gain three packets of 50 Fire for the encounter.

name: Molten Weapon
summary: Hit a weapon for 100 Fire and Disarm 10 seconds.

name: Wall of Fire
summary: Wall up to 10 ft long; crossing it deals Unavoidable 50 Fire. One wall or circle at a time; needs a phys rep.

name: Fire Shield
summary: When hit by an undiminishable melee damage effect, answer with Retaliate Fire Slay.

name: Fireball
summary: One packet: Lash 100 Fire.

name: Shatter Armor
summary: One packet: Fire Shatter Armor.

name: Meteor Swarm
summary: Five packets, one at a time, of 50 Fire.

name: Doom!
summary: For the encounter, gain three Point Fire Slay attacks.

name: Fire Storm
summary: Feet planted, throw repeated Storm 25 Fire until you move, take an effect, use a skill, or the encounter ends.

name: Heatwave
summary: One packet: Lash Magic Shatter Armor.

name: Magic Swarm
summary: Five packets, one at a time, of 50 Magic.

name: Grant Life
summary: Grant 20 Life Points.

name: Life Blade
summary: Target's weapon, claws, or bite deal Essence for the re-pop, or until spent on one attack at +20 Essence.

name: Life Dart
summary: One packet: 25 Essence.

name: Life Spring
summary: Five packets, one at a time, of 5 Healing.

name: Cure Ailments
summary: Clears every standard negative status effect in the rulebook.

name: Cure Wounds
summary: Heal the target to half their maximum Life Points.

name: Life Volley
summary: Gain three packets of 25 Essence for the encounter.

name: Resist Death
summary: One Resist against the next Death effect; when used, the target regains 1 use of a Basic skill.

name: Amplify Healing
summary: Double all healing and Life Repair on the target for the re-pop; does not stack.

name: Mass Grant Life
summary: Voice Radius Grant Life: everyone gains 20 Life Points.

name: Regenerate
summary: After a 60 count the target regrows a limb, heals 100 Life Points, and loses all Aging effects.

name: Return to the Grave
summary: One packet: Lash 100 Essence.

name: Circle of Life
summary: Circle up to 10 ft across that tries to Banish anything walking through it (works on Magic-Plus creatures). One wall or circle at a time; needs a phys rep.

name: Mend Wounds
summary: Heal the target to full Life Points.

name: Raise Dead
summary: Return someone who died this re-pop and has a Spirit Fragment left to life at half Life Points.

name: Word of Life
summary: Voice Radius Slow Undead.

name: Drop of Mending
summary: Refit armor on a 90 count instead of 100, plus 5 packets (3 count each) of Refit 10 Armor. Can be spent in bleed-out to call Mend and stabilize at 0 Life.

name: Grant Resist Elements
summary: Grant one use of Resist Elements.

name: Ice Armor
summary: Grant 20 Armor Points.

name: Slick
summary: Magic Slick: target walks at most one step per second while the caster is in sight, plus 5 seconds. Movement-impairing.

name: Silence
summary: One packet: Silence 10 seconds.

name: Group Ice Armor
summary: Four targets each gain 20 Armor Points.

name: Imprint Read
summary: Learn about a touched item as with the Augury skill; only notable or treasured items carry an imprint.

name: Refreshing Draught
summary: One packet: Restore one Skill.

name: Slow
summary: Gain three packets of Slow 10 seconds for the encounter.

name: Speak with Mentor
summary: Talk for up to 5 minutes through a pool of water with someone who taught you. Cannot cross planes.

name: Destruction Protection
summary: Lash Grant Destruction Protection: up to 12 nearby targets become immune to the Destruction debuff.

name: Ice Prison
summary: Magic Imprison 20 seconds: target disabled and untouchable by anyone, caster included. A barrier; can be disenchanted.

name: Banish
summary: One packet: Magic Banish.

name: Water Shield
summary: Whenever the target takes damage they may Retaliate Charm Ignore at the attacker (damage still applies).

name: Armor Storm
summary: Feet planted, throw repeated Storm 20 Armor until you move, take an effect, use a skill, or the encounter ends.

name: Tsunami of Dispersal
summary: Gain three packets of Magic Banish for the encounter.

name: Refreshing Rain
summary: One packet: Lash Restore One Skill.

name: Surge of Mending
summary: One packet: Lash Refit Armor.
